payout_quote: Checking Offer. Valid promo code must be included on application. Only for new Chiefs Checking or Cashback Free Checking accounts with a limit of one per membership. Offer valid through 12/31/2026. Within 60 days of opening the new checking account, the member must have a monthly direct deposit of at least $250 posted to the new checking account. $200 will be deposited into primary savings account within 30 days of meeting qualifications. Must be an employee of a CommunityAmerica At Work Company.
steps: Confirm you are an employee of a CommunityAmerica At Work partner company.
Apply for a new Chiefs Checking or Cashback Free Checking account with a valid promo code included on the application.
Within 60 days of opening, have a monthly direct deposit of at least $250 post to the new checking account.
$200 is deposited into your primary savings account within 30 days of meeting qualifications.
catches: Must be an employee of a CommunityAmerica At Work partner company - not open to the general public.
Requires a valid promo code on the application; one bonus per membership.
Monthly direct deposit of at least $250 must post within 60 days of account opening.

The bonus is generally treated as taxable interest income (typically reported on Form 1099-INT); consult a tax advisor - general bank-bonus tax treatment, not stated in the captured official terms.
All account applications subject to approval; Kansas/Missouri credit union.
